title: Any window from your Mac, on your iPhone and iPad
summary: Sill is an open-source tool that enables users to view and interact with any window from their Mac directly on iPhone and iPad, creating a seamless multi-device viewing experience without requiring complex setup or additional hardware.
problem_solved: Enables remote viewing of Mac windows on iOS devices for multi-device workflows.
why_valuable: Provides a practical, open-source solution for extending Mac display to iOS devices, useful for developers, remote workers, and anyone needing cross-device access to their desktop applications.
